SELECT pollutant_desc, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_environment.echo_icis_air_pollutants WHERE pollutant_desc IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What was the highest hourly output of any power plant in Texas on August 1, 2023?
SELECT facility_name, unit_id, hour, gross_load_mw FROM govblock_environment.campd_emissions_hourly WHERE state = 'TX' AND date = DATE '2023-08-01' ORDER BY gross_load_mw DESC LIMIT 10
Which states have the lowest share of adults who are citizens?
SELECT geoname, round(100.0 * try_cast(cvap_est AS double) / try_cast(adu_est AS double), 1) AS percent FROM govblock_elections.cvap_state WHERE lntitle = 'Total' ORDER BY 2 ASC LIMIT 10
In how many patents does aspirin appear?
SELECT count(DISTINCT c1) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.pubchem_compound_cid_patent WHERE c0 = '2244'
Which NIH institutes gave out the most grant money in fiscal year 2023?
SELECT ic_name, sum(try_cast(total_cost AS double)) AS dollars FROM govblock_grants.nih_projects WHERE cast(fy AS varchar) = '2023' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many medical device recalls were started in 2023?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_health.fda_device_recall WHERE substr(event_date_initiated, 1, 4) = '2023'
Which companies received the most U.S. patents in 2023?

SELECT a.disambig_assignee_organization, count(DISTINCT p.patent_id) AS patents FROM govblock_patents.pv_g_patent p JOIN govblock_patents.pv_g_assignee_disambiguated a ON a.patent_id = p.patent_id WHERE p.patent_date LIKE '2023%' AND a.disambig_assignee_organization <> '' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What is the most rooftop solar ever estimated at one time in New York's Capital zone?
SELECT max(try_cast(mw_value AS double)) AS peak_mw FROM govblock_solar.nyiso_btm_solar_btmestimatedactual WHERE zone_name = 'CAPITL'
Which states have the highest income per person?

SELECT g.name, try_cast(a.value AS double) AS per_capita_income FROM govblock_census.acs1_2024 a JOIN govblock_census.acs_2024_geos_1yr g ON g.geo_id = a.geo_id WHERE a.geo_id LIKE '0400000US%' AND a.table_id = 'b19301' AND a.variable = 'B19301_E001' ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many lenders filed HMDA mortgage data for 2023?
SELECT count(DISTINCT lei) AS lenders FROM govblock_finance.hmda_ts WHERE cast(activity_year AS varchar) = '2023'
Which federal courts see the most securities lawsuits?
SELECT c.full_name, count(*) AS dockets FROM govblock_courts.dockets AS d JOIN govblock_courts.courts AS c ON c.id = d.court_id WHERE d.nature_of_suit LIKE '850%' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What share of Regulations.gov dockets are rulemakings?
SELECT round(100.0 * avg(CASE WHEN replace(dockettype, '"', '') = 'Rulemaking' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 1) AS percent FROM govblock_regulations.regulations_gov_dockets
What are the tallest wind turbines in California?
SELECT p_name, t_model, try_cast(t_ttlh AS double) AS total_height_m FROM govblock_energy.wind_uswtdb_uswtdb_v WHERE t_state = 'CA' ORDER BY 3 DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
How many distinct compounds has SureChEMBL extracted from patents?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.surechembl_compounds
Which New York institutions have drawn the most NSF award dollars?
SELECT name, round(sum(try_cast(awardamount AS double))) AS dollars FROM govblock_grants.nsf_awards WHERE statecode = 'NY' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many consumer product recalls did the CPSC announce in 2023?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_consumer.cpsc_recalls WHERE substr(recalldate, 1, 4) = '2023'
In which states is energy most expensive per million Btu?

SELECT substr(series_id, 12, 2) AS state, try_cast(value AS double) AS dollars_per_million_btu FROM govblock_energy.eia_seds_data WHERE series_id LIKE 'SEDS.TETCD.%.A' AND length(series_id) = 15 AND substr(series_id, 12, 2) NOT IN ('US', 'X3', 'X5') AND period = '2023' ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How much revenue did New York's school districts take in during fiscal 2017?
SELECT sum(try_cast(totalrev AS double)) AS revenue FROM govblock_education.ccd_sdf WHERE cast(year AS varchar) = '17' AND stabbr = 'NY' AND try_cast(totalrev AS double) > 0
Which modes of action are most common among drugs with a known mechanism?
SELECT action_type, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.chembl_drug_mechanism WHERE action_type IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many people worked in oil and gas extraction in 2023?
Jobs and Wages by County and Industry
SELECT try_cast(annual_avg_emplvl AS double) AS jobs FROM govblock_labor.qcew_annual WHERE area_fips = 'US000' AND agglvl_code = '15' AND own_code = '5' AND industry_code = '211' AND year = '2023'
Which states have the most students eligible for free school lunch?

SELECT statename, sum(try_cast(student_count AS double)) AS students FROM govblock_education.ccd_sch_033 WHERE school_year = '2024-2025' AND data_group = 'Free and Reduced-price Lunch Table' AND lunch_program LIKE 'Free lunch qualified%' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many 510(k) clearance decisions were made in 2024?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_health.fda_device_510k WHERE substr(decision_date, 1, 4) = '2024'
In which counties do subsidized households have the lowest average income?

SELECT name, states, try_cast(hh_income AS double) AS household_income FROM govblock_housing.hud_psh_county WHERE program_label = 'Summary of All HUD Programs' AND try_cast(hh_income AS double) > 0 AND try_cast(total_units AS double) >= 500 ORDER BY 3 ASC LIMIT 10
Who pays for more New York hospital stays, Medicare or Medicaid?
SELECT payment_typology_1, count(*) AS discharges FROM govblock_health.ny_sparcs_inpatient_discharges GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
Which New York counties have the highest median home values?

SELECT g.name, try_cast(a.value AS double) AS median_home_value FROM govblock_census.acs1_2024 a JOIN govblock_census.acs_2024_geos_1yr g ON g.geo_id = a.geo_id WHERE a.geo_id LIKE '0500000US36%' AND a.table_id = 'b25077' AND a.variable = 'B25077_E001' ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many published applications came through the international PCT route?
SELECT count(DISTINCT pgpub_id) AS applications FROM govblock_patents.pv_pg_pct_data
At which companies did insiders give away the most shares as gifts in 2023?

SELECT s.issuername, sum(try_cast(t.trans_shares AS double)) AS shares_gifted FROM govblock_sec.sec_insider_nonderiv_trans t JOIN govblock_sec.sec_insider_submission s ON s.accession_number = t.accession_number WHERE t.trans_code = 'G' AND t.trans_date LIKE '%-2023' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many recipients received at least one federal contract in the last 12 months?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_awards.usaspending_db_rpt_recipient_profile WHERE recipient_level = 'R' AND try_cast(last_12_contracts AS double) > 0
Which federal circuits saw the most civil filings in the Federal Judicial Center's records?
SELECT c.full_name, count(*) AS cases FROM govblock_courts.fjc_integrated_database AS f JOIN govblock_courts.courts AS c ON c.id = f.circuit_id GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many census blocks does the 2020 block crosswalk list for Texas?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_labor.lodes_xwalk WHERE stusps = 'TX'
Which Florida cities recorded the most fatal crashes in 2022?
SELECT cityname, count(*) AS crashes FROM govblock_vehicles.fars_accident WHERE statename = 'Florida' AND cast(year AS varchar) = '2022' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many New Yorkers were admitted for complications of diabetes in 2016?
SELECT count(*) AS stays FROM govblock_health.ny_sparcs_inpatient_discharges WHERE discharge_year = '2016' AND ccs_diagnosis_description LIKE 'Diabetes mellitus with complications%'
Which states have the most inventors named first on patent applications?
SELECT inventor_region_code, count(*) AS first_inventors FROM govblock_patents.patex_inventors_25 WHERE inventor_country_code = 'US' AND first_named_inventor = 'Y' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What is the systematic IUPAC name for aspirin?
SELECT c1 AS iupac_name FROM govblock_chemistry.pubchem_compound_cid_iupac WHERE c0 = '2244'
Which journals have published the most articles?
SELECT display_name, try_cast(works_count AS double) AS works FROM govblock_scholarly.openalex_sources WHERE type = 'journal' ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What did a typical NIH R01 research grant cost in fiscal 2024?
SELECT round(avg(try_cast(total_cost AS double))) AS avg_total_cost FROM govblock_grants.nih_projects WHERE cast(fy AS varchar) = '2024' AND activity = 'R01' AND try_cast(total_cost AS double) > 0
Which environmental laws are enforced in the most EPA cases?
SELECT statute_code, count(DISTINCT case_number) AS cases FROM govblock_environment.echo_case_law_sections WHERE statute_code IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many registered trials mention COVID in their title?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_health.ct_studies WHERE lower(brief_title) LIKE '%covid%'
Which federal agencies have barred the most companies from contracting?
SELECT excluding_agency, count(*) AS exclusions FROM govblock_awards.sam_exclusions WHERE classification <> 'Individual' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What number of trials on ClinicalTrials.gov focus on Parkinson's disease?
SELECT count(DISTINCT nct_id) AS trials FROM govblock_health.ct_conditions WHERE lower(condition) LIKE '%parkinson%'
